title: Pure Empowered Warrior
summary: Pure Empowered Warrior Pendulum and Rank 4 build, supported by Aether, the Empowering Dragon, Aether, the Evil Empowering Dragon, and generic Pendulum and Warrior staples. Empowerment recruits any Empowered Warrior directly from the Deck each turn to assemble Scales and Pendulum Summon the Level 6 Aether bosses for repeatable bounce and banish removal.

summary.title: Starters
points: Empowerment (searched by Terraforming) boosts your Dragon, Warrior, and Spellcaster monsters by 300 ATK/DEF and discards 1 card once per turn to Special Summon any Empowered Warrior directly from the Deck.
Reinforcement of the Army searches any Level 4 Empowered Warrior—Dragodies, the Empowered Warrior (Scale 2), Dragonox, the Empowered Warrior (Scale 7), or Terratiger, the Empowered Warrior.
Terratiger, the Empowered Warrior Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Warrior from your hand in Defense Position when Normal Summoned, setting up an immediate Rank 4 Xyz or Link-2 play.

summary.title: Opening: Empowerment + Level 4 Warrior
steps: Activate Empowerment and discard a card to Special Summon Dragodies, the Empowered Warrior or Dragonox, the Empowered Warrior from the Deck.

Normal Summon a second Level 4 Warrior (such as Terratiger, the Empowered Warrior) and Link Summon Beyond the Pendulum, paying 1200 LP to search the missing Scale (Scale 2 Dragodies or Scale 7 Dragonox) or Aether, the Evil Empowering Dragon.

Place Dragodies and Dragonox in the Pendulum Zones and Pendulum Summon Level 4 Warriors from the Extra Deck alongside Aether, the Empowering Dragon and Aether, the Evil Empowering Dragon from the hand.
Overlay two Level 4 Pendulum Warriors into Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracoslayer to search another Pendulum Monster during the End Phase.

summary.title: Pendulum Scales & Flip Synergy
summary.text: Dragodies, the Empowered Warrior (Scale 2) halves an attacking monster's ATK from the Pendulum Zone and searches any Warrior or Spellcaster with 2000 or less ATK during the End Phase when destroyed. Dragonox, the Empowered Warrior (Scale 7) ends the opponent's Battle Phase from the Pendulum Zone, and on the field discards a card to revive a Warrior or Spellcaster with 2000 or less ATK in face-down Defense Position—reusing Hydrotortoise, the Empowered Warrior to destroy an opponent's Spell or Trap when flipped face-up.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Aether, the Empowering Dragon returns 1 card on the field to the hand every time it is Normal or Special Summoned, while Aether, the Evil Empowering Dragon banishes 1 monster on the field on Normal or Special Summon. Because both are Level 6 Pendulum Monsters, they recur from the Extra Deck every turn under Scales 2 and 7.
Beyond the Pendulum pops 2 cards on the field after you Pendulum Summon two monsters with different Levels, which triggers Dragodies if you destroy your own Scale.
Ventdra, the Empowered Warrior can attack directly, and Arnis, the Empowered Warrior recruits a Spellcaster with 1500 or less ATK when destroyed by battle.

summary.title: Spells
points: Empowerment is both the primary consistency engine and a permanent 300 ATK/DEF boost for all Warriors and Aether Dragons.
Terraforming and Reinforcement of the Army (both Limited) provide extra copies of Empowerment and your Level 4 Pendulum Scales.

allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Empowerment Field Spell (1 copy, Limited in TCG).

allow.Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracosla: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Pendulum Empowered Warriors that searches any Pendulum Monster during the End Phase.
